g.text: I ship systems end to end, and I measure before I claim.
a debug log that shipped with the BigQuery Read API in 2021 and survived five years

a provider dropped the stop sequences its same-protocol twin forwards
42% faster predicate construction, plus a silent empty-filter bug
a test assumed symlinks instead of detecting them, invisible to an Ubuntu-only CI
English-only detectors misjudge other languages in both directions
Bitcoin sanctions screening over n hops
EGFR discovery, every model vs a baseline
live in-browser benchmark, Rust vs JavaScript
CI gated by garak red-teaming and F1/MAE
